summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs announced that its coding agent 'muse code' is live in beta, built on the muse spark 1.2 model, with an install command shared for users.

practices.reason: A new coding agent with its own install path is a new developer surface a team would need to evaluate before adopting.
practices.quote:
muse code in beta is live. first coding agent from msl, built on muse spark 1.2.

install: curl -fsS https://t.co/TFXsXfJKW8 | bash

notable_reason: First coding agent shipped by Meta Superintelligence Labs marks a new product line even though the post itself gives no technical detail.
